objective: Classify each missing prerequisite observed during completed read-only I0 inspection without supplying it.

categoryDefinitions.FIXTURE: Missing test or sample corpus content or provenance.
categoryDefinitions.GENERATED_ARTIFACT: Missing derived configuration or generated build metadata.
categoryDefinitions.DEPENDENCY: Missing, floating, or unresolved package, manifest, revision, or dependency reference.
categoryDefinitions.CREDENTIAL: Missing credential or secret required by an observed surface.
categoryDefinitions.ENVIRONMENT_PREREQUISITE: Missing host tool, platform, network capability, or safe output-isolation proof.
